exposurePolicy: One multiplier: pi / clear-profile horizontal RGB-Y irradiance. Maps the clear 18% Lambertian card to linear Y=0.18 before either display transform. Freeze across every profile, material mode and pose; no fitted offsets.
limitations: Documented model conditions, not a measured local weather station. Aerosol scale is model-specific, not turbidity or measured AOD.
Four-wavelength spectral quadrature and fitted multiple scattering; fixed model ground albedo 0.3. Surface materials are not yet calibrated under AI 566.
CIE S011/E:2003 / ISO15469:2004 overcast luminance law only; D65 RGB chromaticity and 10000 lux are explicit experiment assumptions. The 2024 DIS is a draft.

683 multiplies the model's CIE-Y spectral integral to obtain estimated photometric illuminance, never arbitrary RGB watts. Sun-disc limb darkening in pinned Blender reduces its integral by approximately 0.8.
Cycles owns sunlight entirely in the atmospheric world. Game candidate uses a disc-free environment plus one finite directional sun; uniform angular sun approximates the model's limb-darkened disc.
